_README: Ballpark ranges used by the MCP tool get_ballpark_estimate and the /api/estimate endpoint. REVIEW AND ADJUST THESE TO LIQUID BUILD'S REAL PRICING before relying on them. Units: per_sqft = USD per square foot; flat = USD per project; per_mw = USD per megawatt of critical IT load; per_lot = USD per lot of horizontal sitework. Tiers: standard / mid / high finish.

new_custom_home.label: New custom home
new_custom_home.notes: Conditioned area. Excludes land, pool, landscaping, furniture and design fees unless design-build.

addition.label: Home addition
addition.notes: Additions cost more per square foot than new homes because of tie-ins to the existing structure.

whole_home_renovation.label: Whole-home renovation
whole_home_renovation.notes: In a flood zone, work over 50% of the structure's value can trigger FEMA substantial-improvement rules.

impact_windows_doors.label: Impact windows and doors
impact_windows_doors.notes: Typical single-family home. Product lead times drive the schedule.

restaurant_buildout.label: Restaurant build-out
restaurant_buildout.notes: Second-generation spaces with existing grease trap and hood are at the low end.

school_renovation.label: School or campus renovation
school_renovation.notes: Phased around the school calendar; summer windows are the usual target.

new_school.label: New charter or private school building

data_center.label: Data center (all-in construction)
data_center.notes: Per MW of critical IT load, including electrical and mechanical systems. Utility interconnection and long-lead switchgear, transformers and generators usually set the schedule.

community_sitework.label: Single-family community sitework (horizontal)
community_sitework.notes: Clearing, fill, roads, drainage, water and sewer per lot. Homes priced separately with new_custom_home or production rates.
